case.name: real128_sentinel
case.note: Processor-specific supported kind sentinel; GNU14 REAL128=16, candidate=-1. Not differential output agreement.

case.name: erfc_extreme_composition
case.note: Independent 120-digit oracle; 2ULP REAL4 /4ULP REAL8, never relative relaxed comparison. GNU14 prematurely overflows/underflows these endpoints; compile only.

case.name: runtime_erfc_overflow
case.note: Overflowing argument is candidate safety-policy probe, GNU compile only.

case.name: runtime_undefined_target_pointer
case.note: Undefined association status is invalid even when first pointer is disassociated; no GNU execution.

case.name: runtime_expired_pointer
case.note: Pointer owner lifetime has ended; GNU must not execute undefined pointer-status inquiry.

case.name: runtime_empty_shift_undefined
case.note: CSHIFT evaluates SHIFT once even when ARRAY is empty.
